Constituency Development Plan: Service is the legacy, development is the resolve.

1) Administration and Good Governance - Transparent, accountable and people-oriented administration, weekly grievance redressal and solving local problems, zero tolerance against corruption and nepotism, fast and easy citizen services through digital media.

2) Women Empowerment and Safety - Effective implementation of the "Ladki Bahin" scheme, health, skill training and employment opportunities for women, creches, women's restrooms and safe public places, strengthening women's safety with the help of CCTV and police cooperation.
3) Senior Citizen Welfare - Independent help and guidance center for senior citizens, accessible government services and health check-up facilities, emergency response system and safety measures.

4) Youth and Skill Development - Skill training, digital education and promotion of startups, sports, fitness and personality development programs, career guidance, employment fairs and training camps.
5) Education System - New schools, study rooms and public libraries, high-speed Wi-Fi and digital facilities for students, development of leadership qualities along with quality education.
6) Health Facilities - Modern government hospitals and special treatment centers, burn care unit and capable ambulance service, strengthening primary health care services.

7) Environmental Protection - Tree plantation, increasing green cover and biodiversity conservation, pollution control measures to maintain clean air, water conservation and youth participation in environment-friendly initiatives.
8) Water Supply and Sanitation - 24x7 water supply and robust drainage system, proper disposal of rainwater, waste segregation, cleanliness campaigns and a plastic-free ward.
9) Roads and Infrastructure - Repair of roads, safe footpaths and streetlights, traffic improvement and planned hawking zones, parking facilities and excellent connectivity.
10) Slum Development and Housing - Transparent implementation of SRA and rehabilitation schemes, basic civic amenities and legal aid, guarantee of dignified and safe housing.
11) Security System - CCTVs, police help centers and regular patrolling, increasing safety through citizen participation.
12) Culture and Social Unity - Preservation and promotion of local cultural heritage, encouragement to arts, sports and social activities, equal development of all sections of society.
This is a firm resolve to make Ward 20 a safe, clean, capable and ideal ward.
